description: This file defines the CityFinder class, which provides static methods to set geographic coordinates and retrieve city names based on location data within an Android application.

classes.name: CityFinder
classes.description: A utility class for handling city-related location operations, such as setting latitude and longitude and retrieving city names from location data.

methods.name: setLongitudeLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude and longitude in the LocationCord class based on the provided Location object.

methods.name: getCityNameUsingNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves the city name corresponding to the provided Location object using Android's Geocoder.
